name: ground-route-allocator
description: From the title screen, enter the first world and let it settle, then poke a sentinel into $5F28, the packed world-grid corner byte the renderer reads as $5E40 + slot for ground-extent slot $E8, and break on the next write while walking forward. Names the code that allocates the scene slots below $F0 from the list at $05499E (#281).
